stage: S4a (iteration 3): closed-loop control-law invention by Nemotron vs compute-matched non-AI structure (development data; never confirmatory). Decides G4.
panel_note: 24 NEW development creatures (not M1/S2 dev, not L2, not S3); generated once before any unit; panel sha256 in every unit
start: 15-D R2 controller (family 15, NO foot placement): structure must come from the method

method_notes.fix15: no new structure; FIX rule over opt_body/opt_posture/opt_timing
method_notes.generic: blind structure: the two generic linear mechanisms (8 gains over d, v, pitch, pitch_rate on swing and stance hip) + FIX rule
method_notes.randmech: random DSL mechanisms (2 per round, 2 rounds) + FIX rule
method_notes.expert: REFERENCE, not a comparator: the human-designed swing-foot-placement law written in the DSL + FIX rule
method_notes.ai_1shot: MechDirector one_shot: one investigation round (mechanisms + probes), no feedback loop, then the final plan
method_notes.ai_iter: MechDirector iterative: up to 4 rounds with physical feedback from train/diag seeds (fitted gains, deltas, post-probe gait features); may revise, switch cause or stop

model: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, production config (thinking off), strict JSON schemas, one repair per call, order shuffling with recorded seeds, <= 12 requests per pipeline
accounting: equal TOTAL budget 3,000 per method: start evaluation, every probe (incl. mechanism probes and their 4-seed post-probe diagnostics), every plan, screening (incl. the original's screen for selection v2) charged; assessment uncharged and identical
selection: mech_pipelines selection v2 for every method: (passes the verdict distance bar on screen, screen walking, screen median)

analysis.G4: PASS iff ai_iter full recoveries >= max(fix15, generic, randmech) + 3 (of 24)
analysis.capability_1: ai_iter vs ai_1shot full recoveries (paired table); revision metric: share of revised mechanisms whose probe improved on the revised one (delta walking, then delta fitness) vs share of new proposals that improved
analysis.mechanism_analysis: what Nemotron invented: targets, legs, signals used; whether any proposal is equivalent to swing-hip feedback on d and v; how often fitted gains stayed ~0
analysis.descriptive_only: 24 creatures, one replicate; no significance claims

inference: <= 12 requests per AI pipeline, unique ledger ids per method/creature; global caps $15 / 1,500 requests
